notifications_method.label: Notification Method
notifications_method.help: Completion notification method. auto selects based on terminal, osc9 sends OSC 9, bel sends terminal bell, off disables notifications.

notifications_threshold_secs.label: Threshold
notifications_threshold_secs.help: Only triggers notifications for successfully completed turns that take >= this value, default 30s. Failed/cancelled turns are always silent.

notifications_completion_sound.label: Completion Sound
notifications_completion_sound.help: Completion sound. beep uses the system default beep, off disables it, bell sends terminal bell, file plays a custom WAV.
